tools.name: start_signup
tools.title: Create signup link
tools.description: When the human wants Tyton set up, ask: Want me to help you set this up with Tyton? Only after the human says yes, create their signup/payment/Connect link. A free audit is optional: pass a saved audit's audit_id and audit_key to bring it along, or otherwise site_url (the customer's live https website, confirmed with them). Existing paid accounts skip payment. Keep poll_token private; only share authorization_url. This grants no access or tracking activation by itself.

site_url.description: The customer's website (https) when there is no saved audit. The customer sees and approves it before connecting.

tools.name: get_signup_status
tools.title: Check signup status
tools.description: Privately check the customer's signup/Connect request. Use request_id and poll_token from start_signup, never put the token in a URL or customer message. After explicit owner approval, returns this connection's server key for secure host configuration. Poll no faster than every 5 seconds; stop on expiry/unavailable. Connection is not tracking activation.

tools.name: begin_audit
tools.title: Begin free audit
tools.description: Start here for a NEW audit. Generates a private capability and initial requestId before any database write, so a lost save response can be retried safely. Nothing is saved yet. Retain these privately; pass audit_id, audit_key, revision 0 and request_id from this result to the first evidence tool. Existing audits use read_audit instead.

tools.name: read_audit
tools.title: Read audit
tools.description: Resume this audit with its private capability. Returns recorded context, scoped observations, provenance and component coverage; use existing answers and findings rather than asking the human again. This does not verify the site's backend or grant access to it.

revision.description: latest run revision; 0 only for first write after begin_audit; read_audit recovers the current revision

request_id.description: fresh UUID per mutation; reuse exactly for an identical retry after a lost response

tools.name: record_audit_context
tools.title: Record audit answers
tools.description: Record answers for this component. Inspect first, then ask decision.questions before closing. Do not infer human answers. audit_scope records the human's continue_investigation/public_only choice; availability_expectation records whether unavailable controls are expected. Use the question's URL. These choices must be human_reported. A public-only choice allows a partial handoff without repeated access requests. Prior topics are retained; a new answer replaces that topic. No secrets or raw source.

audit_id.description: audit run ID returned by Tyton; unrelated runs must not share it

audit_key.description: private audit write capability returned by Tyton; never put in a public report, URL or user-facing summary

revision.description: latest run revision; 0 only for first write after begin_audit; read_audit recovers the current revision

request_id.description: fresh UUID per mutation; reuse exactly for an identical retry after a lost response

conversion_goal.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

marketing_site.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

app_backend.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

repository_scope.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

consent_expectation.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

access_limitations.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

audit_scope.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

availability_expectation.description: A concise non-sensitive answer and its actual source; inference is not confirmation

tools.name: record_audit_runtime
tools.title: Record runtime evidence
tools.description: Record bounded evidence from the agent's real browser, authorized backend inspection or destination UI in the SAME audit run. This tool does not run a browser or send events. Do not invent observations; report unknown when a capability/access is missing. Never upload network payloads, cookies, tokens, source, personal data or event IDs. Consent changes, form submissions, bookings and test events require separate authorization.

audit_id.description: audit run ID returned by Tyton; unrelated runs must not share it

audit_key.description: private audit write capability returned by Tyton; never put in a public report, URL or user-facing summary

revision.description: latest run revision; 0 only for first write after begin_audit; read_audit recovers the current revision

request_id.description: fresh UUID per mutation; reuse exactly for an identical retry after a lost response

evidence.description: sanitized summary of the inspected observation; no payloads/identifiers/credentials

tools.name: audit_site
tools.title: Audit a public page
tools.description: Inspect one public page's HTML and save a partial audit report without signup. Call begin_audit first and pass its session fields for the first save; reuse the session for related components. Returns evidence, limitations and discovery actions, not a full tracking-health verdict. Discover the actual conversion journey and related app/backend; inspect available evidence before asking the human material unanswered questions. Optional sanitized HTML is agent-supplied, unverified evidence; never upload private source, personal data or credentials.

audit_id.description: audit run ID returned by Tyton; unrelated runs must not share it

audit_key.description: private audit write capability returned by Tyton; never put in a public report, URL or user-facing summary

revision.description: latest run revision; 0 only for first write after begin_audit; read_audit recovers the current revision

request_id.description: fresh UUID per mutation; reuse exactly for an identical retry after a lost response

html.description: Authorized sanitized page HTML, including local previews. Entire JSON-RPC request must fit 256 KiB after JSON escaping. Larger pages need a focused capture; never upload private source or personal data.

fresh.description: bypass the short public-page cache when verifying a change

tools.name: setup_tracking
tools.title: Discover or configure site
tools.description: Discover and plan reviewed v2 setup. URL-only is read-only and needs no Pixel; with a real Pixel ID this configures the connected project, not its approval or activation. Preserve existing installations; use verification mode before authorized live sends.

url.description: the site being tracked — domain or full URL

pixel_id.description: Meta Pixel ID, numeric — omit if you don't have it yet

name.description: project name; defaults to the site name

checkout_domains.description: hostnames where checkout happens, if already known

confirm_change.description: true = yes, switch this project to a different Pixel ID or site URL on purpose

tools.name: setup_status
tools.title: Read site configuration
tools.description: Read connected-project configuration and resume the reviewed v2 workflow. Configuration/token status is not plan approval, callback verification, activation or Meta receipt.

tools.name: submit_findings
tools.title: Submit code findings
tools.description: Submit scoped findings from a repository confirmed to belong to the customer. Include reviewed_files (relative paths only, no source). Unknown is not failed and does not mean code reviewed. Do not call just to fill unknown fields; investigate first, ask material unanswered questions, or share a clearly partial report. Group labels alone do not combine multiple properties. Findings are agent-reported, not verified deployed behavior.

audit_id.description: audit run ID returned by Tyton; unrelated runs must not share it

audit_key.description: private audit write capability returned by Tyton; never put in a public report, URL or user-facing summary

revision.description: latest run revision; 0 only for first write after begin_audit; read_audit recovers the current revision

request_id.description: fresh UUID per mutation; reuse exactly for an identical retry after a lost response

url.description: the site these findings belong to

reviewed_files.description: relative paths actually inspected in the relevant customer repository; no source code, absolute paths or secret files

not_applicable.description: Only after reviewing relevant files and confirming scope: checks that do not apply, with the actual reason. Missing access is unknown, never N/A.

server_side_events.description: code sends server-side events (CAPI/SDK/webhook)? unknown if you could not check

server_evidence.description: one line: file/function where you found it

dedup_ids.description: orderId/event_id on both browser and server events?

pixel_in_code.description: Meta Pixel initialized anywhere in the code?

payment_provider.description: payment processor used (check package.json, env vars, webhook routes)

backend.description: where is the backend code? in this repo, a separate repo you can't see, or unknown

existing_capi.description: if you found existing CAPI code, grade it: hashes_pii (does it hash emails/phones before sending?), sends_event_id (does each server event include an event_id?), graph_version (which Graph API version, e.g. v19.0), test_event_code_in_prod (is a test code left in production?), sends_fbp_fbc (are browser cookie values forwarded?)

graph_version.description: Graph API version used, e.g. v19.0

sends_fbp_fbc.description: fbp/fbc cookie values forwarded in server events?

checkout_domains.description: domains the checkout lives on, if separate; no customer paths or query strings

group.description: legacy grouping label only; does not combine reports or verify domain ownership

notes.description: anything else you found. String or array of strings — whatever is natural

tools.name: read_docs
tools.title: Read Tyton guidance
tools.description: Read Tyton guidance before coaching a customer. meta_setup shares the dashboard's nine-step Meta business/dataset/website/CAPI/test checklist; optionally request one step. website_management explains the persistent selector, per-project agent connection and confirmed deletion. Also install, events, dedup, crawler_protection, create_pixel, create_business, consent, pricing, privacy, performance, gtm, platforms, faq. Give the current next actions with exact labels and links, not the whole guide at once. Read-only instructions, not saved checklist state or proof of delivery.

step.description: Optional Meta setup step; only used with topic meta_setup.

tools.name: get_setup_progress
tools.title: Read setup progress
tools.description: Resume this connected site's setup. Read saved plan approval, installation generation, missing callback sources and intentional pause in one compact response. Follow its one next step; do not repeat completed discovery, pairing or staging. Read-only: no approval, activation or test events. Callback evidence is not business success or Meta receipt. Missing Meta credentials do not block verification-only setup.

tools.name: save_capi_token
tools.title: Save Conversions API token
tools.description: Save the customer's supplied Events Manager Conversions API token for this connected site's current Pixel. Pass exactly one of capi_token or sealed_capi_token, with the Pixel ID. Ask for missing credentials; never invent or auto-fill demo values. Prefer secure input. If the customer has already supplied a token and asks you to configure it, use it here without echoing it. The token is encrypted, never returned. Pixel ID must match setup_tracking/current configuration. Rejects explicit invalid/expired-token responses; otherwise saves with delivery unchecked. Continue setup after saving. Does not send a test conversion, approve, activate or prove delivery. The Tyton browser extension may give the customer a sealed token (it starts with `tyton_sealed_v1.`). Pass it exactly as given in `sealed_capi_token` with the Pixel ID. Never decode, shorten, retype or echo it, and never ask for the raw token when a sealed one was given.

sealed_capi_token.description: A sealed token from the Tyton browser extension, exactly as given (starts with tyton_sealed_v1.).
